description: Writes lessons as Claude Code skills (.claude/skills/hexacore-<name>/SKILL.md) so the client loads them natively. Without lessonIds exports every proven lesson (helped at least 3 times, at least 70% effective) not exported yet. Reversible through rollback_changes.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

name: export_skills
title: Export lessons as Claude Code skills
